item.title: Europe's free satellite service just made it easier to track wildfires
item.description:
📝 The Copernicus Browser provides free access to the latest satellite imagery taken by the European Space Agency’s Sentinel satellites for the European Union’s Earth observation program. Now Copernicus Browser has also added a straightforward “wildfires” visualization layer for Sentinel-2 imagery that went live on August 4. That helpful wildfire visualization enhancement comes from a script written in JavaScript by remote sensing expert Pierre Markuse.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/08/europes-free-satellite-service-just-made-it-easier-to-track-wildfires/
